caption: A blanket is pulled off a bed by one corner and dragged across the floor.

sa.check: A blanket lies on a bed.
It is pulled by one corner.
It is dragged across the floor.
The pull comes first, then the slide off, then the drag.

pc.expect: The blanket slides off and trails in soft folds, bunching where it catches.
pc.fail: It is a rigid sheet; or it stretches; or it tears.

pc.expect: It follows the pull and does not move ahead of it, and it keeps its size.
pc.fail: It moves ahead of the pull; or grows; or shrinks.

pc.expect: It moves only while it is pulled.
pc.fail: It slides off by itself; or moves after the pull stops; or jumps.

pc.expect: It falls off the bed edge to the floor and lies on it.
pc.fail: It floats; or hangs in the air; or rises.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The blanket's pattern and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The pattern changes; or the bed changes; or the room rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
